regime.reason: P1360 changes the public compile CLI contract and target-specific serialization and therefore requires an independently authored observable contract, adversarial discrimination, a sealed mutation score, and a later independent verdict.

authority.environment: shared workspace with read/write capability restricted by declared allowlists
authority.causal_predecessor: P1360 preflight and updated L0 prompts existed before this contract

baseline.purpose: language and public CLI intent oracle; byte identity with its exporters is not required

result_domain.preserved: Every mandatory observable for the case is established and all applicable preservation controls pass.
result_domain.violated: At least one mandatory observable differs, with a public witness and reason_code.
result_domain.unknown: Identity, parsing, construction, extraction, normalization, timeout, size, or budget is insufficient to decide safely.

unknown_policy.may_satisfy: Only a case explicitly classified as opaque whose expected result is Unknown.
unknown_policy.dynamic_gate_action: stop the dynamic gate and report the public reason_code

in: compile diagnostics for accepted and rejected spellings
L4 resolution None to false and target-only forwarding
orthogonality of PDF serialization, StreamMode, and PdfTags
SVG and HTML structural whitespace only
preservation of target, feature, HTML escaping mode, layout, diagnostics, and unrelated commands
out: object identity, object numbering, xref spelling, or exact line counts
pretty configured inside the Typst language
watch loop behavior or any watch subprocess execution
general PDF, SVG, HTML, or PNG equivalence

parser_assertions: the token false is not consumed as the boolean value of --pretty
the token false remains subject to the command's existing positional rules
separated_token.compile_positional_witness: with an unfilled output positional, false is parsed as the output path; the ratified vanilla process later exits 1 because the output format cannot be inferred, not because clap rejected the boolean
separated_token.watch_and_w_constraint: assert only through Args::try_parse_from; where an output positional is available, false occupies it, otherwise the existing positional parser decides independently of --pretty

must_identify: the invalid or misplaced value when present

parse_tri_state.execution_constraint: watch and w are parser-only via Args::try_parse_from; they are never spawned

invariants: pretty does not select or change output format
pretty does not activate HTML feature
pretty does not change layout or evaluated content
only the selected target encoder receives the resolved boolean

pdf.fixture_requirements: finite deterministic document with at least one profitable page content stream, visible text/operators, and no artifact above 4 MiB
pdf.page_content_stream_identification: resolve each Page /Contents reference through a bounded PDF parser; do not classify font, image, ICC, metadata, object, or xref streams as page content streams
compact_default_false: decoded operators and rendered morphology are preserved
pretty_true: page operators are present in clear text and parse as a valid content stream
decoded operator sequence and rendered morphology equal the corresponding pretty=false case
font, image, ICC, and metadata compression policies are unchanged

stream_mode_matrix.invariant: pretty controls page-stream compression/readability; compact controls operator vocabulary only; all four combinations remain expressible
stream_mode_matrix.witness: for fixed compact value, toggling pretty preserves the decoded operators; for fixed pretty value, toggling compact preserves document morphology while retaining the selected pretty compression policy

pdf_tags_matrix.invariant: pretty never enables or disables tags; all four combinations remain expressible
pdf_tags_matrix.witness: tagged structure markers follow PdfTags alone while page-stream FlateDecode follows pretty alone

svg.fixture_requirements: finite page exercising text, attributes containing > inside quotes, at least one nested group, geometry, and escaping
svg.compact: absence and --pretty=false have compact serialization with no structural indentation requirement
svg.equivalence: parse both outputs as XML and compare the ordered tree including element names, namespaces, ordered child relation, attributes, text nodes carrying semantic text, references, geometry, and paint after discarding indentation-only nodes introduced between elements
preserve: IDs modulo alpha-renaming with graph isomorphism
fonts, destinations, and explicit fallback markers
svg.forbidden_shortcut: raw-byte or line-count equality is not the tree oracle

html.fixture_requirements: finite semantic content exercising document/head/block boundaries, phrasing text, title/raw context, void element, protected space, escaped attributes including >, and both HtmlSerializationMode values
html.compact: absence and --pretty=false preserve the compact encoder
html.pretty: --pretty=true adds a final newline and two-space indentation only at structural document, block, and head-metadata boundaries
html.equivalence: parse compact and pretty as HTML and compare the ordered DOM, attributes, text semantics, void/raw behavior, protected spaces, and selected escaping mode after excluding formatter-owned indentation nodes at declared structural boundaries
html.tokenization_guard: a > character inside a quoted attribute value does not close a tag for formatting purposes

serialization_mode_matrix.invariant: pretty changes only structural whitespace; escaping remains selected solely by HtmlSerializationMode

png.invariant: pretty is accepted by compile but is not forwarded to or interpreted by the PNG exporter
required_observations: successful compile under the same finite fixture
same dimensions, color model, alpha behavior, and decoded pixel morphology
no pretty-dependent diagnostic or target change
png.strong_control: when the deterministic encoder yields stable bytes for the same frozen inputs, all three SHA-256 values must match; decoded morphology remains the normative oracle

must_hold: compile errors and warnings unrelated to --pretty retain severity, channel, ordering, and exit class
eval, query, and info retain their independent existing pretty behavior and argument domains
watch and w reuse the tri-state parser but no watch loop is exercised
output selection, features, HTML target, HTML serialization, layout, PDF tags, StreamMode, and PNG rendering remain independent
absence and explicit false are equivalent at each exporter while remaining distinct parser states
existing public wrappers produce compact serialization by default

case_families.population: three commands times four accepted spellings

case_families.expected: Violated for a parser that accepts the spelling; Preserved for the required rejection
case_families.population: three commands times two rejected equals-form spellings

case_families.expected: Preserved only when --pretty is Some(true) and false is left to existing positional parsing
case_families.population: compile, watch, and w parser-only cases for --pretty false
absence, false, and true with ordered-tree comparison
pretty x HtmlSerializationMode matrix plus absence control
ambiguous PDF page-stream ownership, malformed XML/HTML/PDF, unresolved reference graph, artifact over limit, timeout, or exhausted budget

required_mutations.description: collapse absent and explicit false in the parser intent
consume the separated token in --pretty false as the option's boolean value, resolve Some(false), or reject it as an invalid --pretty boolean instead of leaving it to positional parsing
required_mutations.reclassification: The previous mutation incorrectly required parser rejection. The valid adversarial mutation now targets consumption or boolean rejection of the separated token; baseline acceptance as a positional token is the preserved behavior.

required_mutations.description: accept invalid or empty boolean as false
watch or w does not share compile tri-state parsing
None resolves true or compatibility wrappers default to true
pretty changes StreamMode or compact changes pretty
pretty changes PdfTags or tagging changes pretty
pretty page content streams retain FlateDecode
pretty disables compression for fonts, images, ICC, or metadata
default or explicit false disables profitable page-stream compression
SVG true is ignored or false is indented
SVG pretty changes graph, attributes, geometry, escapes, or painting order
HTML pretty inserts whitespace inside phrasing, title, text, attribute, void/raw, or protected-space content
HTML formatter treats > inside a quoted attribute as tag closure
HTML pretty changes the selected escaping mode
PNG output or diagnostics depend on pretty
Unknown, timeout, oversize, malformed, or ambiguous evidence is credited as Preserved
pretty changes target, feature activation, layout, or unrelated eval/query/info behavior

discriminatory_gate.seal_condition: all positive cases Preserved, all valid required mutations Violated with witnesses, all deliberate opaque cases Unknown, and repeated/reordered execution has the same classification vector
discriminatory_gate.unknown_action: zero credit and do not seal unless it is the expected result of an explicit opaque case
discriminatory_gate.repetition: at least two identical-order runs after focal success
discriminatory_gate.reordering: forward and reverse case order produce the same vector
discriminatory_gate.protected_input_change: invalidate this contract candidate and restart from the first affected phase

execution_safety.stdout_stderr: redirect each stream to a bounded file; unlimited capture is forbidden
execution_safety.test_scope: one focal crate or one focal test target at a time
execution_safety.red_policy: after the RED cause is localized, do not repeat an integral compilation solely to reproduce it
execution_safety.limit_failure: timeout, oversize, capture overflow, or budget exhaustion classifies Unknown with zero credit and stops the dynamic gate

calibration_budget.stop_rule: two consecutive revisions with the same classification vector and dominant reason_code require architectural review before another complete run
calibration_budget.budget_semantics: budget exhaustion never weakens an observable and never converts Unknown to Preserved

final_gates_expected_after_seal: independent focal tests derived from this frozen contract
limitations: This artifact is a candidate contract, not a seal or certificate.
No oracle suite, mutation run, implementation verdict, or isolation certificate is claimed here.
The contract covers only P1360 observables and does not establish general functional equivalence with vanilla.
